operations.description: Read-only view of every configuration group (storage, compute, auth, …) as resolved from the serving replica's environment at boot; secret values are never included, only whether they are set. Super-admin only, session-only.

operations.summary: List all users in the identity directory
operations.description: Every user who has signed in at least once, name-sorted. Currently a single page (`next_cursor` is always null). Super-admin only, and session-only: a PAT — even a super admin’s — is rejected with 403.
Deployment-wide audit trail, newest first. Super-admin only. Date ranges are inclusive and limited to 30 UTC days.

Mint a machine credential that acts as the calling user (CI, scripts, the CLI): send it as `Authorization: Bearer mhub_pat_…`. The plaintext token is returned once, in this response, and never again. Requires session (SSO) auth — a token cannot mint tokens.

properties.name: expires_in_days
properties.description: Days until expiry; omit for a non-expiring token.

operations.summary: List the caller's personal access tokens
operations.description: Metadata only — the secret is never retrievable after creation.
Deletes the token; API requests using it fail within the verification-cache TTL (~30 seconds) on other replicas, immediately on this one.

Add a member by user id or email. A known email resolves to its user id; an unknown email becomes a pending invite that grants access when that person first signs in.
Pending email invites are visible only to project managers (plus the invitee themself); other callers see the id-keyed rows only.

Resolve user ids to display identities
operations.description: Batch-resolve opaque user ids (the auth `sub` stored as a notebook `author` or session `user_id`) into `{ id, email, name, picture_url }`. Ids with no recorded identity are omitted from the result map.

Case-insensitive substring search over email, name, and id, for the add-member picker. Only users who have signed in at least once are in the directory. Under MARIMOHUB_DEFAULT_ROLE=none the caller must own or belong to at least one project — a signed-in account with no involvement cannot enumerate the directory; with a default role set, every authenticated user may search.
Just the version string. The rest of the build/runtime identity (image, replica, backends, …) is super-admin material on `GET /api/v1/admin/config`.
